title.zh: 查到两条仓库温度记录

brief.zh: 记录员想查看仓库里达到 20°C 的温度记录。
brief.en: The record keeper wants storage readings of at least 20°C.

concept.zh: 用 WHERE 把区域条件和温度条件一起应用到每一行。
concept.en: Use WHERE to apply the area and temperature conditions to every row.

hints.zh: 保留全部列。仓库的三次测量是 20°C、16°C 和 24°C。
hints.en: Keep all columns. Storage recorded 20°C, 16°C, and 24°C.

label.en: Set the area and temperature floor

prompt.zh: 输出仓库中温度至少 20°C 的记录，保留所有列并按记录编号排列。
prompt.en: Return storage readings at 20°C or above, with all columns, in ID order.
